query:
UPDATE payments
                        SET payment_date = $3::text::date,
                            amount = $4, payment_method = $5,
                            payment_ref = $6, received_by_rep_id = $7,
                            notes = $8, version = version + 1
                      WHERE id = $1 AND order_id = $2 AND version = $9
                     RETURNING version
